title: Platform Engineer
description:
📍 Hybrid working - London Office (Aldgate East, E1) 2 days per week with 3 days working remotely

The Opportunity:

- Deliver High-Impact Roadmap Projects: Lead key initiatives including our AWS Cognito authentication migration, Azure-to-AWS referencing platform migration, and new AI product infrastructure.

- Shape & Scale Compute Platforms: Manage and enhance containerised workloads on EKS, serverless AWS Lambda services, and Datadog observability.

- Drive Long-Term Improvements: Balance day-to-day product engineering support and incident response (~40%) with turning recurring problems into permanent, automated fixes.

- Build in a Fast-Moving Environment: Take meaningful responsibility for production systems while helping shape technical solutions in a collaborative, ISO 27001-compliant team.

 

What we need from you:

- Cloud & Infrastructure Experience: Solid hands-on experience running production workloads on AWS, managing Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, or GKE), and using Terraform for infrastructure as code.

- CI/CD & Scripting: Experience building CI/CD pipelines (ideally in GitHub Actions), working with Docker, and writing clean scripts or code in Python, Go, or Bash.

- Identity & Serverless: Experience building serverless services (AWS Lambda) alongside a strong grasp of OAuth2, OIDC, and managed identity providers (e.g. AWS Cognito, Entra ID, Auth0).

- Collaborative Problem-Solving: A developer-first mindset with strong judgement, thoughtful use of AI tools, and a proactive approach to resolving issues and sharing input early.

Our mission:

- Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Goodlord's mission? To be the gold standard platform for renting 🌎

- We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution 🏠

- Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,000 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 350+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission! 💚

 

WHY YOU'LL LOVE BEING A GOODLORDIAN

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

- Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified https://www.greatplacetowork.co.uk/certified-company/1558877. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

- Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

- 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

- Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

- Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

WHAT’S NEXT?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

• Math & Operations Research: Practical, expert-level application of linear/nonlinear optimization, rigorous statistical analysis, reinforcement learning, and advanced predictive forecasting.

• Production ML/LLMOps at Scale: Extensive experience in designing deployment architectures and dictating reliability standards for production-grade AI across cloud providers (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, GCP Vertex AI).

title: A/P Specialist
description:
Come join our family! If you are interested in truly making a difference in a collaborative and rewarding work setting with a culture of respect, accountability, appreciation, and loyalty, Microbac might be the right place for you!

We offer a positive working environment with engaged and supportive leadership teams along with competitive pay and benefits including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, generous paid time off including vacation, holidays and flextime, a wellness program, referral bonus, tuition reimbursement and more!

ABOUT MICROBAC

Microbac Laboratories, Inc . is a premier commercial laboratory testing firm that partners with clients nationwide, offering laboratory solutions to life science, food and nutrition, and environmental industries and serves our clients with the utmost expertise and respect for their market requirements, constraints, and challenges. We embody a company-wide commitment to exceptional customer experience, which has been refined by over 50 years of trusted, analytical and measurement experience.

As a privately held third-party testing company, Microbac operates with a commitment to our workforce, safety, quality, and compliance. Our diverse work portfolio includes broad accreditation offerings and tested insights across the environmental, food and nutrition and life science markets.

JOB SUMMARY

The Accounts Payable Specialist is responsible for processing and completing payments, and controls expenses by receiving, processing, verifying, and reconciling invoices, and ensuring payments are made in accordance with due dates.

MAJOR/ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

• Provide timely support to laboratory technical and administrative staff by effectively addressing administrative and clerical needs

• Thorough understanding of company finance system

• Accounts Payable (AP): review vendor invoices, code and submit to corporate

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Vendor invoices: Confirm all orders that have been placed have an associated invoice and it has been entered into ERP system; no missing invoices

• Customer Service: Secondary person for customer calls

• Third Party Invoicing: Ability to navigate all third-party invoicing systems

• Issues payments to vendors through check run and credit card

• Research payment discrepancies on accounts

• Posts and files AP batches containing invoices from labs

• Enters physical invoices into accounting software system and saves to network

• Prepares and mails checks twice a month

• Responds to vendor calls and emails requesting payment status, update account, etc.

• Responds to lab requests though calls and emails

• Responsible for coding the accounts payable credit card and enter payment details in the system, when card is used

• Assist with yearly audit

• Print and mail out 1099’s, yearly

• Ability to investigate problems associated with vendor accounts

• Manages laboratory inventory and supply ordering

• Accomplishes accounting and organization mission by completing related results as needed

• Limited time off on:

• Wednesdays (AP batch uploads)

• 1st business day of the month (monthly invoices)

• Last day of the month (to assure everything is invoiced)

• Any other duty as assigned

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

• High school degree or equivalent

• Minimum 1 year of experience

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

• General knowledge of basic accounting practices

• General knowledge of accounting software

• Precise data entry skills and PC proficiency

• Excellent customer service and communication skills

• Ability to analyze information

• Protects the organization’s value by keeping information confidential

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Associates degree in accounting or a related field of study

• Prior experience with accounting, accounts payable (AP), or accounts receivable (AR)

• Experience working with accounting software

title: Operations Associate (Order Processing)
description:
About Us
BukuWarung is SEA's fastest-growing startup and we are building the digital infrastructure for 60 million MSMEs in Indonesia, enabling them to efficiently manage and grow their business - starting with digital bookkeeping, online storefront, and payments. BukuWarung 's vision is to empower 60 million MSMEs in Indonesia to become financially aware and enable them to manage and grow their business using technology.
BukuWarung is backed by top-tier VCs globally: Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Goodwater Capital, Y-Combinator, AC Ventures, Quona Capital, East Ventures, Golden Gate Ventures, Rocketship.vc, Tanglin Venture Partners and strategic angel investors from Stripe, PayPal, Plaid, Grab, Gojek, Facebook, AirBnB, Fast, Mastercard, etc.
Role Overview:
Help get payment devices into the hands of merchants across Indonesia - one clean order at a time.
What you'll do:

•
Move orders out the door, cleanly. You'll be the bridge between what merchants order and what ships - turning our order data into the format our warehouse partner needs, with zero room for mistakes.

•
Own the inbound flow. When new devices arrive from suppliers, you're the person who logs them in, tracks every serial number, and keeps our records airtight from day one.

•
Close the loop daily. Pull shipment data, confirm everything's updated in our system, and make sure no order quietly slips through the cracks.

•
Be the connector. Work across Partnership, BD, Merchant Success, Marketing, and Product - plus our warehouse and 3PL partners over WhatsApp. Keep threads moving until issues are actually resolved.

•
Help us through a big move. We're migrating warehouses. You'll be one of the steady hands making sure today's operations don't miss a beat while tomorrow's setup goes live.

What we're looking for:

•
2-4 years in operations , warehouse, e-commerce, fintech, payment ops, or admin/billing roles

•
A track record of getting bulk data right the first time - you take pride in accuracy

•
Strong spreadsheet skills you actually trust (VLOOKUP, pivots, conditional formatting, CSV processing)

•
Solid written Indonesian; comfortable holding vendor and stakeholder conversations over email and WhatsApp

•
The kind of person who closes loops - when you say you'll follow up, you do

• Ready to start immediately and commit through the contract

title: Field Enablement Manager
description:
The Team

The APJ Enablement Team empowers our Sales, Customer Success, and Technical Solutions teams with the right information, skills, and tools throughout their tenure at Datadog in order to maximize their ability to land, expand, and drive Datadog’s next phase of growth across the region. We act as strategic partners to the APJ Leadership Team, ensuring they have the support they need to achieve their goals. We regionalize and contextualize global programs, custom-build regional programs, and provide just-in-time support in order to deliver quantifiable impact on go-to-market performance in APJ.

The Opportunity

Datadog continues to grow at a rapid rate and with this exciting growth, our onboarding and ongoing training is also quickly increasing in scale and complexity. This position is responsible for providing onboarding and ongoing enablement training/programs to all of our regional go-to-market teams. We are looking for a structured communicator with a knack for simplifying the complex to deliver the training content, curriculum, and programs that enable our sales people to be successful in their jobs.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

• Deliver engaging live and virtual enablement sessions for regional Sales and Customer Success teams, including onboarding, ongoing training, and reinforcement programs.

• Conduct ongoing field listening (shadows, 1:1s, syncs with first-line leaders) to maintain a strong pulse on business needs, gaps, and strengths across APAC markets; share insights with the broader enablement team to shape programs and priorities.

• Lead reinforcement and coaching to drive post-program adoption, including designing activities (role plays, deal clinics, skill practice sessions) that connect training to measurable behavior change in real, complex customer scenarios.

• Partner with Curriculum, Program Management, and Operations to share field insights and pilot or co-build content, and work closely with first-line Sales leaders to build trusted relationships, diagnose challenges, and deliver ad hoc training in response to emerging needs.

• Use AI tools to accelerate delivery and reinforcement - including synthesizing field feedback and surfacing patterns - and model effective AI use for the teams you train.

Who You Are:

• 3-5 years of experience in sales enablement, field enablement, training, or a related GTM role, with a proven delivery track record supporting Sales and/or Customer Success teams in a SaaS or technology environment. 

• Strong facilitator with experience delivering engaging live and virtual training sessions to senior, sophisticated audiences, and familiarity with sales methodologies/frameworks such as MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, Sandler, etc. (certification a plus).

• Strong business acumen and comfort using performance data, field feedback, and qualitative insights to inform enablement decisions; experience with Asana or similar project management tools is a plus.

• Foundational understanding of Datadog and/or the broader technology industry, including foundational knowledge of Datadog's core product pillars (Infrastructure, APM, Logs) and the ability to connect product capabilities to customer value.

• Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented - you build trust quickly with sellers, managers, and cross-functional partners.

• Organized, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently across a large, diverse region.

• Willing and able to travel approximately 25% across APAC.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description: About Orakl Oncology Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials and every failure costs patients years. Orakl exists to change those odds. We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients: real patients’ tumors, paired with their medical history and deep biological data. Because we can test treatments on these virtual patients at scale, we can predict, with causal evidence, how a patient will respond to a drug long before it reaches the clinic. This helps pharma companies bet on the right drugs, for the right patients, much earlier on. We were founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès and Gustave Ronteix, PhD as a spin-out from Gustave Roussy, one of Europe’s leading cancer centers, and we build on 10 years of research. title: Humanitarian Immigration Attorney - T Visa, U Visa & VAWA
description:
Help survivors of trafficking, violence and crime find safety and legal status.
Mangone Law Firm is expanding its humanitarian relief team and is hiring attorneys who already know T visa, U visa and VAWA work. You will handle your own caseload, appear before USCIS and immigration courts, and work with a dedicated paralegal and legal support team.
About Us
Mangone Law Firm, LLC is a New Jersey-based immigration law firm serving clients nationwide since 2012. We were named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies. We combine strong systems, ongoing training and a mission-driven culture so our attorneys can focus on strategy and clients.
Requirements

What You’ll Do

• Lead case strategy and conduct initial case reviews and consultations.

• Review and approve packets, declarations and motions: T visa, U visa, VAWA, SIJS, family-based petitions, consular processing, waivers, RFEs and NOIDs.

• Represent clients at USCIS interviews, immigration court hearings (EOIR), bond hearings, and file motions and appeals (BIA, motions to reopen/reconsider).

• Give feedback to paralegals and legal assistants to keep work accurate and on time.

• Serve as Attorney of the Day, guiding the legal and consultation teams.

What You Bring

• Must have: Active U.S. bar license in good standing (any state).

• Must have: 2+ years of attorney experience handling T visa, U visa and/or VAWA cases.

• Must have: Fluent English and Spanish (written and spoken).

• Must have: Comfort appearing before USCIS and immigration courts.

• Nice to have: I-918B/I-914B certification work, SIJS, asylum, cancellation of removal, waivers; CAST or ASISTA training; case management experience (we use Camplegal, training provided); Google Workspace and Slack.

Not sure you meet every requirement? If you have a bar license and hands-on T, U or VAWA experience, we want to hear from you.
Benefits
What we offer you:

• Competitive Salary: And a mission-driven work environment.

• Health, dental, vision and life insurance.

• 401(k) with employer match and a pension plan.

• Paid time off, holidays and sick leave.

• Bar membership renewal coverage and tuition reimbursement.

• Structured 30/60/90/120-day onboarding and continuous training (CAST, ASISTA and more).

• Support from paralegals and legal assistants on every case.

Stord ’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
Stord is hiring a Director of Revenue Accounting & Assurance to own how we recognize, record and defend revenue across a business that blends warehousing, fulfillment, parcel and software. There is no dedicated revenue accounting team today, so you will own the function from day one: set the technical accounting position under ASC 606, and build the assurance program that gives our CFO, auditors and board confidence in every revenue number we report. What You'll Do

Revenue accounting

• Own the monthly and quarterly revenue close, including accruals for usage-based fulfillment, storage, transportation and parcel charges, and unbilled revenue.

• Own ASC 606 analysis for new and amended customer contracts (MSAs, SOWs, pricing schedules): performance obligations, principal vs. agent, variable consideration, contract modifications and software vs. services allocation.

• Own the revenue recognition policy, technical memos and the revenue recognition playbook, and keep them current as the product mix changes.

• Own the reserves for customer credits (such as service and SLA credits), including the estimation methodology, monthly true-ups and support for auditors.

• Own revenue analytics: revenue by customer, service line and contract, flux and trend analysis, and the metrics that explain revenue movement to Finance leadership.

• Partner with Billing and Systems to make sure contract terms, rate cards and billing data flow accurately into the general ledger.

Assurance and Controls

• Design, run and continuously improve the revenue control environment: SOX-readiness controls, reconciliations, billing-to-GL tie-outs and revenue completeness checks.

• Build an assurance program that tests revenue before it reaches the auditors, using data and analytics to catch billing leakage, duplicate charges and rate-card variances.

• Be the primary revenue contact for external auditors: PBC lists, walkthroughs, technical accounting positions and remediation of findings.

• Prepare for audit, diligence and potential IPO readiness requirements, including disclosures and footnote support.

Leadership

• Lead and scale the revenue accounting function: hands-on today, with any team build-out to be determined as business needs evolve.

• Drive automation of revenue workflows, reconciliations and flux analysis with the finance systems stack.

• Brief the CFO and Controller on revenue trends, risks and judgments.

What You'll Bring

• Bache

title: PhD in AI / Earth Observation / Environmental Science
company: University of Cambridge, University of Manchester
description: University of Cambridge, University of Manchester | PhD in AI / Earth Observation / Environmental Science | ONSITE | UK home fee status only | £30k tax-free annual stipend Our group at Cambridge works on Earth Observation foundation models (Tessera: v1 https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.20380 , v2 https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03949 , https://geotessera.org/ ) and we've started a collaboration with Manchester to understand how they can be used to improve pollution models and then environmental decision making in general. This involves training new models and doing high-resolution inference across national or even global scales, as well as figuring out how to use that data to help policymakers make better decisions. As part of this work we have a PhD studentship through the joint Manchester-Cambridge Centre for Doctoral Training for AI in Decision Making for Complex Systems. This involves one year at Manchester doing taught postgraduate study and then three years at Cambridge for the PhD. Our work is all open source and involves solving significant compute and data challenges. Training our current-generation model takes ~250k GPU hours and a single year of global inference needs to move over 5.5 petabytes of data through the inference pipeline. This project would suit someone with strong machine learning and software engineering experience. We can help you build the atmospheric science and Earth Observation skills. We are a highly collaborative group who spend our time not only on foundational research but also on developing applications with practitioners and decision makers. Our work sees use in many industrial, academic and government environments for problems like crop classification, tree species mapping and change detection. You can find out more here: https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/from-satellite-to-stre... - if you have questions about the project you can contact me, Sadiq Jaffer, at sj514@cam.ac.uk . For questions about the application process you'll want aidecisionscdt@manchester.ac.uk . Application deadline is Friday 4th of December with a course start date of September 2027.

title: Hybrid Board Certified Behavior Analyst
description:
About the Role
FronteraCare is expanding into Southern California through the acquisition of an established ABA practice in the San Diego area. We're looking for a dedicated BCBA to join this team as we bring FronteraCare's technology-enabled model of care into this market.
You'll join an existing practice with an established team, client base, and community presence. This is a hybrid role based within commutable distance of Chula Vista, CA, combining in-person and telehealth care as we integrate our clinical technology and grow our footprint in the region.
We're looking for someone who is a strong clinician first, and who is also energized by the opportunity to be part of a growing organization, adopt new tools, and help shape what technology-enabled ABA care looks like as this market evolves. You'll work alongside the practice's clinical leadership team and connect into FronteraCare's broader clinical, operational, and technology teams.
What You'll Do

• Conduct behavior or functional analytic assessment processes

• Develop case supervision and clinical management plans

• Develop and implement ABA Treatment Plans

• Consult with Registered Behavior Technicians (RBT) or Behavior Technicians (BT) regarding client and family concerns

• Select appropriate stimulus materials and treatment modalities for the age and ability of the person served

• Include the client and family in setting treatment goals, and train families on specific treatment strategies and carryover skills

• Give clear, concise instructions when presenting materials and techniques in therapy

• Record and track daily progress for clients and families accurately

• Utilize session time efficiently to meet treatment objectives

• Provide accurate and immediate feedback to clients and families

• Plan for discharge of the person served

• Support the transition into FronteraCare's clinical model, including adoption of Frontera's assessment, documentation, and data tools

• Provide candid, practical feedback on new tools and workflows as the practice integrates with FronteraCare

What We're Looking For

• Current BCBA certification in good standing with the BACB, with at least 3 years of certification

• Master's degree in Psychology, Applied Behavior Analysis, or a related field

• General knowledge and experience in the field of Applied Behavior Analysis and Autism Spectrum Disorder

• Four or more years of experience working with a pediatric population

• Four or more years of experience in an applied setting participating in functional assessments and analyses, and the development, implementation, and ongoing oversight of behavior plans

• Proficient computer skills in Excel, database management, and record keeping

• Effective oral and written communication

• Excellent interpersonal and coaching skills

• High level of confidentiality and excellent organizational skills

• Bilingual, able to deliver services and communicate with families in both Spanish and English

• Openness to adopting new clinical technology and workflows as the practice transitions into FronteraCare

• Comfort operating through a period of organizational change

Location
This is a hybrid role requiring presence within commutable distance of Chula Vista, CA. This clinician will spend regular time in person with clients, families, and the local team, alongside telehealth service delivery.

As the Solutions Engineer , you will be an individual contributor and play a critical role in driving our company's growth by partnering with the sales team to understand customer needs, design the right technical solution, and effectively communicate the value proposition of our products and services to customers. •
Sales Support: Collaborate closely with the sales team, providing them with technical insights and guidance to advance sales opportunities throughout the pre-sales process.

•
Technical Discovery: Lead technical conversations with customer IT, integration and security teams to understand their systems, data flows and integration requirements.

•
Solution Architecture and Design: Work with customers to understand their business drivers, requirements, and challenges, and architect solutions that address their unique business problems, including integration design across APIs, HL7 v2 feeds, FHIR resources and file-based exchanges.

•
Product Demos: Conduct engaging and informative product demonstrations to customers, showcasing how our solutions meet their specific needs and deliver value.

•
Proposal and SOW Creation: Develop detailed proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs) that outline project scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and pricing, ensuring alignment with customer expectations and company capabilities.

•
RFP Responses: Prepare thorough and compelling responses to Request for Proposals (RFPs) and security questionnaires, addressing technical and business requirements to position our solutions as the best choice for the customer.

•
Handoff to Implementation: Deliver a complete solution package to the implementation team, including requirements, integration specifications, assumptions and open items, to ensure a smooth transition from sale to delivery.

•
Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, acting as a trusted advisor throughout their decision-making process.

•
Market Research: Stay informed about industry trends, competitive products, and emerging technologies to provide valuable insights and guidance to the product development team.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems), or equivalent experience.

• In-depth understanding of the healthcare ecosystem and of cloud-based healthcare solutions - experience in the digital health space is a must.

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
About XYPN

XYPN is the only turnkey advice and planning platform that makes it possible for fee-only financial advisors to build the independent firm of their dreams with complete autonomy. We do this through ongoing advocacy and access to education and training, curated technology, compliance support, community, and back-office and client support services.

This is an opportunity to join a company on a mission to help others-and you-live your best lives.

About the role

As the Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you shape how members experience XYPN at every stage, from the final sales call and onboarding through the ongoing journey of running and scaling their firms. Operating on the belief that members stay when they consistently see and feel the value of their membership, you will partner with the Director of Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders to define the lifecycle strategy and own the execution: the automated programs, segmented campaigns, and member communications that keep that value visible and top of mind.

Using data on member behavior, engagement, and lifecycle stage, you will design and run the journeys, campaigns, and testing that guide members toward deeper benefit adoption and stronger engagement with XYPN, at scale, across the full member base.

You are a storyteller as much as a strategic thinker, committed to learning our members and the realities of running a fee-only RIA. You will craft on-brand communications that inform, inspire, and drive action. Across every touchpoint, from emails to town halls to messaging at XYPN events, you make sure members feel that human connection.

Serving as the primary subject-matter expert for lifecycle marketing across the organization, you will collaborate and work cross-functionally with key departments and stakeholders across the organization, keeping members engaged and supported at every stage.

Where We Hire: We’re excited to review applications from across the U.S., but we give priority to candidates residing in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MN, MT, NC, NE and TX.

What you'll be doing

Lifecycle Marketing Strategy

• Develop and execute the lifecycle strategy for XYPN Emerald and Sapphire members (onboarding, benefit activation, retention, reactivation, expansion).

• Drive adoption of benefits, services, and premium offerings via targeted campaigns.

• Refine member segmentation models using CRM attributes, lifecycle stage, behavioral data, and member-stated interests.

• Maintain communication governance, including audience selection, channel strategy, messaging, contact frequency, and a member preference strategy that lets members choose the communications they receive.

• Consult on demand gen and prospect campaigns with the Sales and Marketing teams and support strategic initiatives as needed.

Campaigns & Marketing Automation

• Design, build, and run recurring, triggered, and automated campaigns across email, member Portal, and other member channels.

• Manage core journeys, including onboarding sequences, weekly member communications, benefit adoption campaigns, and cross-sell programs.

• Manage the member communications calendar, coordinating cadence across all member-facing campaigns and keeping messaging aligned with the prospect marketing team.

• Own marketing communications for twice-yearly Townhalls, XYPN events, and the annual XYPN LIVE conference, driving member engagement and pass sales.

• Write clear, compelling copy in a warm, human voice that matches XYPN’s brand, and collaborate on asset production.

Member Insights, Reporting & Optimization

• Translate member research and performance metrics into actionable lifecycle recommendations

• Execute structured testing roadmaps (messaging, segmentation, timing, channels) to optimize engagement.

• Track and report on core lifecycle KPIs (retention, engagement, reactivation, LTV) to leadership.

• Analyze program outcomes to evaluate impact on member behavior and business goal

title: Network and Security Engineer, Defense
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Network and Security Engineer to own the architecture of high-performance, high-assurance networks for our defense programs. You will design networks that move terabits of radar, camera, and vehicle data with low, predictable latency, and you will secure those networks to the standard needed for classified environments up to Impact Level 6 (IL6). This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who has spent a career solving hard networking and security problems and wants to keep doing so directly, while shaping technical direction across our defense programs and growing into broader technical leadership. At Applied, we encourage engineers to own technical and product decisions, work closely with customers and users, and contribute to a thoughtful, dynamic team culture.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

- Architect and build high-bandwidth network fabrics (100/400/800GbE) that carry mixed radar, EO/IR camera, and vehicle bus data from the sensor edge to compute and storage

- Design for deterministic, low-latency transport using techniques such as Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), precision time synchronization (PTP/IEEE 1588), RDMA/RoCEv2, and multicast for sensor distribution

- Bridge in-vehicle networks (automotive Ethernet, CAN, and legacy military buses) with modern IP-based backbones in rugged, size- and power-limited platforms

- Design and implement security architectures that support IL5/IL6 accreditation, including network segmentation, encryption in transit (MACsec, IPsec, CSfC-style layered encryption), PKI, and cross-domain data flows

- Apply zero trust principles across on-prem, tactical edge, and cloud environments rather than relying on perimeter-only defenses

- Automate network and security configuration with infrastructure as code, and build continuous compliance checks into deployment pipelines in place of manual, document-driven processes

- Build observability into the network through streaming telemetry, flow analysis, and security monitoring so that problems and threats surface quickly

- Translate Navy and DoD guidance into practical engineering decisions, adopting the intent of those standards while pushing toward modern, maintainable solutions

- Work directly with customers, government stakeholders, and product teams across Applied to understand mission needs and deployment constraints

- Set the technical roadmap for defense networking and security, lead design reviews, mentor engineers across teams, and serve as a trusted technical voice with customers and government stakeholders

title: People Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT CONVEO

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/49c7399e-a401-4987-ab34-2ca5e18d2f29/3519e886-495e-4d41-8a3b-439b2a607aea/pictures.jpg]

THE CONTEXT

Conveo is scaling from $4M to $50M, and the People team is running on goodwill and late nights. We have a recruiting team and a new L&D hire joining, but nobody owns the processes and systems underneath them. Compensation schemes, performance cycles and salary reviews all land on Claudia, alongside the daily operational load.

That has to change before we grow further. You'll be the first dedicated People Operations hire, reporting to Claudia. You'll build the operating system for the whole People function: the tools, data, cycles and lifecycle processes that let us hire, pay, develop and support people well across the UK, Belgium and the US.

You'll work closely with Finance on payroll and compensation, with recruiting and L&D on the employee lifecycle, and with managers across the company. When you've done this well, Claudia spends her time on strategy and growing the team, not on firefighting.

YOUR MISSION

1. OWN THE PEOPLE SYSTEMS STACK AND MAKE IT WORK ACROSS EVERY COUNTRY

You decide how our People tools fit together, then make them run. Today that spans an HRIS, EOR and PEO providers, and payroll across several geographies.

- Own the HRIS as the single source of truth for every employee, contractor and EOR hire

- Lead a possible payroll migration end to end: vendor choice, data cleanup, parallel runs, cutover

- Manage EOR and PEO relationships across the UK, Belgium and the US

- Connect systems so data flows once, not through spreadsheets and copy-paste

- Use AI and automation to remove manual admin wherever it adds no judgement

2. BUILD AN EMPLOYEE LIFECYCLE THAT FEELS EFFORTLESS AT 2X OUR SIZE

Every hire, move and exit should follow a clear, repeatable path that works in any country we operate in.

- Design onboarding, internal moves and offboarding flows with recruiting and L&D

- Turn tribal knowledge into documented processes and self-serve answers

- Keep contracts, documents and policies consistent across geographies

- Make the experience good for employees and managers, not just compliant

3. RUN THE PEOPLE CYCLES THE COMPANY DEPENDS ON

Performance reviews, compensation and salary increases should run on time, every time, without pulling Claudia into the detail.

- Own the performance cycle calendar, tooling and manager enablement

- Run compensation projects and salary review cycles with Claudia and Finance

- Keep bands, levels and approvals applied consistently

- Spot what slowed each cycle down and fix it before the next one

4. TURN PEOPLE DATA INTO DECISIONS

Leadership should be able to answer people questions in minutes, with numbers they trust.

- Build reliable reporting on headcount, attrition, compensation and cycle completion

- Keep People data clean enough to support planning and board reporting

- Give Claudia and managers the insight to act early, not after the fact

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

MUST-HAVES

- 5+ years in People Operations, including time at a startup or scaleup through hypergrowth, with hands-on experience across multiple countries (ideally Belgium and the UK)

- Hands-on experience scaling a People function: you've seen what breaks between 50 and 200+ people and helped fix it

- Strong systems thinking: you design processes and tool stacks that hold up as the company grows, not one-off fixes

- Hands-on experience implementing an HRIS (Deel is a big plus) and running at least one people cycle (performance, comp review or onboarding) end to end.

- Comfort working with data: you can build a report leadership trusts, and you notice when the numbers look wrong

MINDS

title: Senior Software Engineer, Layer1

Who You’ll Work With
As a Layer1 software engineer, you will get to work on software that manages the physical layer, where packets meet the outside world. Stable and reliable physical connectivity is critical for any network and that is your challenge. You will get to write control software that brings to life everything from the ubiquitous 1GBASE-T connectors to 400G long reach optics that provide fiber connectivity across continents. Your software will need to work across a wide variety of forwarding engines, connectors and interface chips called gearboxes, which allow our hardware platforms to support diverse physical connectivity options within a product family. You will build instrumentation and telemetry tools that track physical link health parameters reported by the Layer1 components and enable operators to monitor and troubleshoot their links effectively. You will also work closely with our Optics teams to define standards for new media and bring them to market.

• Mentor new and junior engineers to bring them up to speed in Arista's software development environment.

• Expert knowledge of C or C++ and Python .

• Understanding of IP networking and/or distributed systems is a plus

• Experience working with low level hardware components is a plus

• Applied understanding of software engineering principles

• Strong problem solving and software troubleshooting skills

• Ability to design a solution and implement features independently.

• Ability to work in small teams.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.

How We Got Here

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

• B2 Overdrive - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines

• B2 Neo - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media

• B2 Cloud Storage - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in

• Computer Backup - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

The Role

Backblaze is growing quickly, with customers that include some of the biggest AI, media, and cloud infrastructure companies in the world. As our EMEA business grows, we are investing in a dedicated, in-region Enterprise Support team, and we need a Manager to build it and lead it. ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence that benefits all of humanity. Our EMEA organization translates OpenAI’s global mission and strategy into meaningful local impact, working across Growth, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Finance, Research, Operations and Compliance.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Strategy and Operations lead, you will develop country strategies, identify the most important market opportunities and barriers, align cross-functional teams around a focused set of priorities, and personally drive initiatives through to measurable outcomes.

This is an individual-contributor role. The primary focus is Consumer, with opportunities to create adjacent impact across B2B. You will go deep in a small number of priority markets while building approaches that can scale across EMEA.

This is not a strategy-only role. The successful candidate will combine rigorous analysis and market judgment with urgency, hands-on execution and the ability to influence without formal authority.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

- Build country strategies: Develop plans, priorities and forecasts for key European markets and translate company strategy into practical local action.

- Drive growth and conversion: Use data, customer insight and experimentation to improve acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion and monetization.

- Lead market expansion and localization: Identify opportunities, build scalable launch frameworks and determine where products and go-to-market should adapt.

- Turn strategy into execution: Personally move initiatives from diagnosis and prioritization through delivery, measurement and iteration.

- Lead cross-functional teams: Align Product, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Partnerships, Finance, Research, Operations and Compliance around shared outcomes.

- Represent regional insight: Ensure European market and customer perspectives shape global roadmaps and decisions.

- Measure and scale impact: Define success metrics and determine when a successful local approach should be replicated.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

- Have 10 years + of experience in growth, strategy, business operations or quantitative analytics with meaningful responsibility for outcomes.

- Have developed country, regional or multi-market strategies and translated them into focused execution plans.

- Bring exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, including forecasting, financial modeling and growth metrics.

- Can show examples of personally taking initiatives from insight through launch and measurement.

- Understand European markets while maintaining a regional and scalable perspective.

- Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and influence teams without formal authority.

- Operate with high ownership and urgency in ambiguous, resource-constrained environments.

- Have a deep interest in AI and alignment with OpenAI’s mission.

You shape how we solve our customers' finance problems, and you have the final say on whether a release is right before it reaches them. Speak with customers and accounting partners to understand how finance teams work with DATEV and the wider SMB tooling stack. Act as the accounting reference for product teams across Moss. Bring a forward-looking view on accounting tooling into roadmap discussions. title: Senior BI/DW Developer
description:
Job Description:
BI/DW Architect (Finance Analytics & Insights)
Position Summary
The BI/DW Architect (Finance Analytics & Insights) is a strategic leader within the Global Controllership organization responsible for building and managing the finance reporting, analytics, and business intelligence ecosystem. This role partners closely with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Internal Audit, and Finance Systems to transform financial data into actionable insights that support executive decision-making, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance.
This individual serves as the organization's Power BI expert and leads the design, development, and governance of enterprise financial dashboards, KPI reporting, and analytics solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong engineering and data architecture expertise with an understanding of finance and accounting processes to deliver scalable, automated reporting capabilities across the global finance organization.
Key Responsibilities
Finance Analytics & Business Intelligence

• Serve as the accounting organization's subject matter expert for Power BI and enterprise reporting solutions.

• Design, develop, and maintain executive dashboards supporting the Corporate Controller, CFO, Finance Leadership Team, and Audit Committee.

• Build interactive dashboards covering:

• S2P | Supply Chain/Procurement and AP

• Close metrics

• Account reconciliations

• SOX compliance

• Intercompany

• Revenue

• Fixed assets

• AR

• Treasury

• Tax

• M&A integration

• ERP implementation

• Finance transformation initiatives

• Develop self-service reporting capabilities that enable Finance leaders to access timely and reliable operational and financial insights.

Data Engineering & Financial Data Architecture

• Design and maintain scalable financial data models supporting enterprise reporting.

• Build optimized semantic models within Power BI.

• Develop ETL/ELT processes to automate data extraction, transformation, and loading from ERP and finance applications.

• Partner with Finance Systems and IT to establish standardized data pipelines.

• Improve data quality, consistency, and governance across financial systems.

Power BI Center of Excellence

• Establish governance, development standards, security models, and best practices for Power BI.

• Lead dashboard architecture, workspace administration, deployment pipelines, and lifecycle management.

• Optimize report performance and scalability.

• Develop reusable datasets and standardized financial reporting models.

• Mentor Finance users on Power BI capabilities and self-service analytics.

Financial Reporting Automation

• Eliminate manual reporting through automation.

• Develop automated KPI reporting supporting:

• Monthly close

• Quarterly reporting

• SEC reporting

• Audit Committee reporting

• Executive operating reviews

• SOX monitoring

• Integrate reporting across Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, BlackLine, Coupa, and other enterprise applications.

Advanced Analytics

• Develop predictive analytics supporting:

• Cash flow forecasting

• Revenue trends

• Close cycle performance

• Working capital

• AP and AR analytics

• Journal entry monitoring

• Financial risk indicators

• Utilize DAX, Power Query (M), SQL, Python, and AI-enabled analytics to enhance financial decision-making.

• Explore machine learning and AI opportunities to improve financial forecasting and anomaly detection.

Executive Reporting
Develop executive dashboards for:

• Corporate Controller

• CFO

• Finance Leadership Team

• Executive Leadership Team

• Audit Committee

• Board of Directors

Create standardized reporting packages for:

• Close performance

• Financial KPIs

• SOX compliance

• Audit metrics

• ERP implementation

• M&A integration

• Shared services

• Global accounting operations

Finance Transformation
Partner with Finance leadership to:

• Modernize financial reporting

• Digitize accounting operations

• Reduce manual rep
